note: DOD §1 P6 lists only M1-05, M1-07, M1-09 and M10-01 as visual items, so this report is advisory for M1-08 (its verify JSON marks P6 skipped: not-a-visual-item). Scored surface: the /dev/audio gallery, 5 modes x 3 viewports plus stream-sim dusk/night (JPEG q60), interaction states and reduced-motion phone. External-reference A/B 0/4 (threshold 40%). No console errors in any capture. Clip item 12 n/a (no ambient scene).

ab.why: B has a coherent painted world with material and lighting; A is a flat web form with fallback type.
A is crafted low-poly art with a unified palette; B is a dark control panel whose main CTA is unreadable.
A reads as a premium cozy toy world; B is stock UI chrome on a gradient.
B has deliberate party-game art direction and bold typography; A is a generic settings page.

issues.problem: No web fonts are registered at all (document.fonts.size = 0, no woff2 requests); CDP getPlatformFontsForNode reports 'Segoe UI Black' for the title, so every string renders in the OS fallback, not Fredoka/Nunito.
issues.rule: SPEC §13.4 fonts (Fredoka 500-700 display, Nunito 500-800 UI); SPEC §4 fontsource self-hosted
issues.fix: Import @fontsource-variable/fredoka and @fontsource-variable/nunito (latin subsets) in the gallery entry (or @sg/ui fonts.ts once M1-05 merges) and await document.fonts.ready before first paint.

issues.problem: Night-mode primary CTA uses ui-ink #F5EDE3 on accent #FFB36B: measured 1.52:1 contrast; the label is nearly invisible, also at stream-sim q60.
issues.rule: DOD §4.2 item 11 contrast >= 4.5:1; SPEC §13.2 night tokens
issues.fix: On accent fills use a dark on-accent ink in every mode (night ui-bg #1F1D33 on #FFB36B is ~10:1); label Nunito 700 1rem.

issues.problem: Reads as a generic flat web form on a sky gradient: stock range sliders, OS fallback fonts, border-only cards with no depth, no paper/clay material, no tinted shadow language. Lost the external-reference A/B 4/4.
issues.rule: DOD §4.2 item 1 (stock widgets = <=5); SPEC §13.1 'Soft, not flat', 'Toy-real'
issues.fix: Build the gallery from @sg/ui components (Button, Card, Chip) and tokens: ui-surface translucent cards, 3 px darker base borders, tinted shadow per mode token (e.g. dusk #7A3F5C @32%, 0 6px 16px), radius md 16 / lg 24.

issues.problem: Gut check: a stranger sees a developer control panel/template, not a premium indie product surface.
issues.fix: Resolve M108-R1-01/03/05/08/09/13; add a hero 'now playing' panel with an animated 24 px master level meter so the page has one crafted focal surface.

issues.problem: No focal point: four equal-weight stacked cards; the only emphasised element (Enable sound) is the lowest-contrast element in night and vanishes after unlock; the master level meter is an empty ~12 px hairline at the very bottom.
issues.rule: DOD §4.2 item 6 (one obvious focal point; action -> state -> context)
issues.fix: Make the unlock CTA a 48 px button (Fredoka 700 1.25rem) that morphs into a status chip; move the master meter to a header panel at 24 px height with accent fill and peak hold; section headers h2 1.5rem Fredoka 600.

issues.problem: At 720p JPEG q60 the 13 px card descriptions, 12 px key hints and 14 px hint line smear; state (which bed/music is active) is conveyed only by a 2 px border colour change.
issues.rule: DOD §4.2 item 2; SPEC §13.1.3 (>= 22 px critical text at 1080p); SPEC §13.4 small never used for information
issues.fix: Descriptions 0.875rem Nunito 600; active state = accent fill at 18% + check glyph, not border colour alone; status chip text >= 16 px with glyph.

issues.problem: html/body are transparent and the gradient lives on #audio-gallery whose min-height:100% does not resolve, leaving a pure #FFFFFF band below y=928 in every mode (glaring in night).
issues.fix: html,body{height:100%;background:var(--ui-bg)}; gallery min-height:100dvh with the sky-top->sky-bottom gradient (background-attachment: fixed).

issues.problem: Native <input type=range> (appearance:auto, accent-color only): OS thumb and a near-black grey track in the light modes.
issues.rule: DOD §4.2 item 9 (default controls = <=5); SPEC §13.1.1 no pure black
issues.fix: appearance:none; 8 px pill track in ui-line with accent fill; 24 px thumb with 3 px darker base border and tinted shadow; >= 44 px hit area.

issues.problem: Hover, selected, last-played and focus-visible all render as the same 2 px coral border; the vote card's permanent purple border reads as a selected/focused state.
issues.rule: DOD §4.2 item 9 (visible states); SPEC §13.3 audience #B58AF0 reserved for audience UI
issues.fix: hover: translateY(-2px) + shadow, out-soft 240 ms; selected: accent 18% fill + check glyph; last played: 400 ms glow pulse then clear; focus-visible: 3 px ring offset 3 px; vote: small audience chip/glyph instead of a border.

issues.problem: Buttons are 44 px tall with a uniform 2 px border and no base: flat pills, not chunky toy buttons.
issues.rule: SPEC §13.4 buttons 48 px tall with a 3 px darker base border
issues.fix: height 48 px; border-bottom 3 px in the darker accent/line variant; press compresses the base to 1 px.

issues.problem: Weights/scale off-spec: Nunito 400 body and buttons, Fredoka 800 title, off-scale 13 px and 18 px sizes, ui-monospace 12 px key hints, percentages without tabular-nums.
issues.fix: Body/buttons Nunito 600; title Fredoka 700 2rem; section heads 1.5rem; descriptions 0.875rem; key hints Nunito 700 0.75rem in a pill; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on level readouts.

issues.problem: Row heights differ (75 vs 58 px); 'Piece land · rises per hop' wraps and pushes the tok title up out of line with its row; row 2 leaves two empty cells.
issues.rule: DOD §4.2 item 9 (consistent spacing, no misalignment); SPEC §13.4 4-pt grid
issues.fix: grid-auto-rows:1fr, titles top-aligned with 12 px padding, 5-column grid at >= 960 px (2 x 5), shorten the tok description.

issues.problem: Unlocking removes the Enable sound bar and jumps all content up 60 px in one frame; press feedback is only an opacity dip that lowers text contrast, with no scale or spring.
issues.fix: Keep the slot and morph the bar into a status chip (out-soft 240 ms); press = scale .96 with snappy spring 520/34, release via back (.34,1.56,.64,1) 320 ms.

issues.problem: Mode identity is only the background gradient; rain and snow read as near-identical pale greys and no glow/shadow tokens are applied.
issues.rule: SPEC §13.2 per-mode glow and shadow tokens
issues.fix: Apply per-mode shadow/glow tokens to cards and active chips (night glow #FFB45E halo, rain shadow #3A3F55 @34%) and a mode glyph in the header chip.

issues.problem: The 980 px single column leaves ~470 px dead margins each side at 1080p while the page still scrolls at 720p.
issues.fix: Two-column desktop layout (SFX left; ambience/music/mix right) at >= 1280 px with 24 px gaps on the 4-pt grid.

issues.problem: Streamer mode moves the user's Music slider from 60% to 35%, conflating the user level with the -12 dB duck.
issues.fix: Keep the slider at the user value; show a separate '-12 dB streamer' badge and a duck indicator on the meter.

issues.problem: At 360x800 the ten sound cards stack full width (~660 px of scroll) and keyboard hints 1-0 show on touch devices.
issues.fix: 2-column grid below 480 px; hide kbd hints under @media (hover:none).

issues.problem: Hard seam where the gradient ends and the white band begins.
